title: The Fire Escapes’ First Ballet
description: On the evening of the first snow, the fire escapes lift their steps into the alley. The neighbors watch from their windows as one staircase bows to the other.
alt: Snow-dusted iron fire escapes curve toward each other above a brick alley. Neighbors watch from amber-lit windows, and laundry hangs below.
pairing: A city’s first-snow holiday × a ballet danced by fire escapes
